face.name: 灭世巨龙死亡之翼
face.text: 战吼：消灭所有其他随从。每消灭一个随从，便弃一张牌。
face.flavorText: “他是死亡之翼？那个也是死亡之翼？你也是死亡之翼！？我才是死亡之翼！这里到底有多少死亡之翼？”

face.name: Deathwing the Destroyer
face.text: Battlecry: Destroy all other minions. Discard a card for each destroyed.
face.flavorText: "He’s Deathwing? That one's Deathwing? You're Deathwing!? I'm DEATHWING! ARE THERE ANY OTHER DEATHWINGS I SHOULD KNOW ABOUT?"

face.name: 酸喉
face.text: 每当有敌方随从受到伤害时，将其消灭。
face.flavorText: 在老伙计恐鳞的帮助下，酸喉能够轻易地咬穿板甲。看来有些骑士要倒大霉了！

face.name: Acidmaw
face.text: Whenever an enemy minion takes damage, destroy it.
face.flavorText: With the help of his trusty sidekick Dreadscale, the giant jormungar Acidmaw is ready to face any knight!

face.name: 阿努巴拉克
face.text: 亡语：召唤一个4/4并具有“亡语：召唤阿努巴拉克”的蛛魔。
face.flavorText: 他以前曾是个好人，直到遇见了巫妖王。

face.name: Anub'arak
face.text: Deathrattle: Summon a 4/4 Nerubian with "Deathrattle: Summon Anub'arak."
face.flavorText: Was actually a pretty nice guy before, you know, the whole Lich King thing.

face.name: 先知者沃
face.text: 扰魔。在你施放一个法术后，&发现一张来自过去的自然法术牌。
face.flavorText: 她冥想了两个星期，心无旁骛地探知着宇宙的每一个角落，事无巨细，无所不包。当她从冥想中醒来，口中只吐出了一个声音：“喔。”

face.name: Farseer Wo
face.text: Elusive After you cast a spell,& Discover a Nature spell from the past.
face.flavorText: For two weeks, she meditated in silence, undisturbed as she peered into the endless, unfolding facets of the universe. No pathway lay unexplored, no stone left unturned. When she finally snapped from her fugue, she uttered a single word: "Woah."

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies.deathwing: Existing accepted Battlecry destruction request, exact successful original victim count and ordinary payer discard continuation; actual physical linked face remains source.
policies.acidmaw: Existing damage_dealt trigger and original live residence guard; positive actual damage to a current enemy minion only; captured-target destruction.
policies.anubarak: WON_076 dies into its actual primary-linked WON_076t DBF102751, whose named Deathrattle summons a fresh WON_076. Preserve separate AT_036/AT_036t cycle. Ordinary SummonByCard uses actual cause and same-side original death slot; no hand return or state carryover.

uncertainties: Exact CN death checkpoints, control/silence windows and destroyed-count notifications retain existing documented local policies.
Complete past domain is preserved and remains unbound while actual executable dependencies are missing.
Copy/child links and complete printed faces establish a fixed local binding, not observed official execution or latest CN hotfix calibration.
